bug_locations: rolling_mean function - missing null (None) return when fewer than min_periods values are available
rolling_mean function - window validation only checked for <= 0, not the full spec requirements
explanation: Three bugs were present: (1) There was no validation that 1 <= min_periods <= window, as required by the spec. (2) The function never returned null/None for positions where the number of available values is less than min_periods — it always computed a mean. (3) The logic was compressed into a list comprehension that made it impossible to conditionally return None. The fix adds the min_periods validation, converts to a loop, and appends None when len(slice_) < min_periods, otherwise appends the mean.
